cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Circle from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786" LIGHT = "#DDE4E7"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.linewidth": 1.5, })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) fig.text( 0.04, 0.944, "Halving Lemma", fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", va="center" ) fig.text( 0.96, 0.944, r"$N=4,\quad N/2=2$", fontsize=12, ha="right", va="center", color=SLATE ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.845, r"$\omega_N^{\,2}" r"=\left(e^{\,i\,2\pi/N}\right)^2" r"=e^{\,i\,2\pi/(N/2)}" r"=\omega_{N/2}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16 )
fig.text(0.04, 0.755, "a Same destination on the unit circle", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold") fig.text(0.435, 0.755, "b Two exact 2-point DFTs", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold")
fig.add_artist(Line2D( [0.405, 0.405], [0.145, 0.765], transform=fig.transFigure, color=LIGHT, linewidth=0.9 ))
ax = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.165, 0.35, 0.565]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.58, 1.57) ax.set_ylim(-1.30, 1.49) ax.axis("off")
ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=LIGHT, linewidth=1.2)) for end in [(1.36, 0), (0, 1.29)]: start = (-1.37, 0) if end[1] == 0 else (0, -1.19) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=8, linewidth=0.85, color=SLATE, zorder=0 )) ax.text(1.40, -0.10, "Re", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center") ax.text(0.08, 1.32, "Im", color=SLATE, fontsize=9) ax.text(0.07, -0.16, "0", color=SLATE, fontsize=8)
def curved_step(radius, angle_start, angle_end, color, linestyle="-"): theta = np.linspace(np.deg2rad(angle_start), np.deg2rad(angle_end), 120) x, y = radius * np.cos(theta), radius * np.sin(theta) ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linewidth=1.8, linestyle=linestyle, zorder=3) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (x[-8], y[-8]), (x[-1], y[-1]), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, linewidth=1.8, color=color, zorder=4 ))
curved_step(0.83, 3, 88, BLUE) curved_step(0.83, 93, 178, BLUE) curved_step(1.15, 2, 178, TEAL, "--")
ax.scatter([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, -1], s=30, color=BLUE, edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.8, zorder=5) ax.scatter([-1], [0], s=94, color=TEAL, zorder=6) ax.scatter([-1], [0], s=30, color=BLUE, edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.8, zorder=7)
ax.text(1.07, -0.20, r"$1$", fontsize=10) ax.text(0.12, 1.00, r"$i=\omega_4$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, va="center") ax.text(-0.08, -1.17, r"$-i$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, ha="right") ax.text(-1.15, -0.27, r"$-1$", fontsize=10, ha="center") ax.text(0.46, 0.40, r"$90^\circ$", color=BLUE, fontsize=9, ha="center") ax.text(-0.46, 0.40, r"$90^\circ$", color=BLUE, fontsize=9, ha="center") ax.text(-0.87, 1.05, r"$180^\circ$", color=TEAL, fontsize=9, ha="center")
fig.text(0.045, 0.151, r"$\omega_4=e^{i\,2\pi/4}=i$", fontsize=10, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.222, 0.151, r"$\omega_2=e^{i\,2\pi/2}=-1$", fontsize=10, color=TEAL) fig.text( 0.213, 0.084, r"$\omega_4^2=i^2=-1=\omega_2^1$", fontsize=13, ha="center" ) fig.text( 0.213, 0.035, "Two quarter-turns = one half-turn", fontsize=9, color=SLATE, ha="center" )
x = 0.435 fig.text( x, 0.677, r"Replace $\omega_4^{-2mk}$ with $\omega_2^{-mk}$.", fontsize=11 )
fig.text( x, 0.572, r"$E_k=\sum_{m=0}^{1}x_{2m}\,\omega_2^{-mk}$", fontsize=13, color=BLUE ) fig.text( x + 0.028, 0.484, r"$=x_0\,\omega_2^{-0\cdot k}+x_2\,\omega_2^{-1\cdot k}$", fontsize=12 ) fig.text( x + 0.028, 0.416, r"$\longrightarrow$ Exact 2-point DFT of even samples " r"$[x_0,x_2]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=10.5, color=BLUE )
fig.text( x, 0.316, r"$O_k=\sum_{m=0}^{1}x_{2m+1}\,\omega_2^{-mk}$", fontsize=13, color=TEAL ) fig.text( x + 0.028, 0.228, r"$=x_1\,\omega_2^{-0\cdot k}+x_3\,\omega_2^{-1\cdot k}$", fontsize=12 ) fig.text( x + 0.028, 0.160, r"$\longrightarrow$ Exact 2-point DFT of odd samples " r"$[x_1,x_3]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=10.5, color=TEAL )
fig.text( x, 0.069, r"Periodicity: $\omega_2^2=1" r"\ \Rightarrow\ E_{k+2}=E_k,\quad O_{k+2}=O_k$", fontsize=10.5 ) fig.text( x, 0.026, r"Independent bins: $k=0,1$; the sequences repeat for integer $k$.", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE )
